## Result
Claimed solved after one substantive author turn: an explicit terminating **theoretical algorithm** for Plamondon’s literal Problem 3.4. It has **no efficiency bound and is not a complete software implementation**. Existing PPP surface construction and APS line-field/derived-equivalence classification are fully credited. No historical novelty or external peer-review claim.

The frozen candidate reconstructs the polygonal surface, enumerates rational PL geometric-handle certificates using finite exact predicates, proves the search terminates, and computes winding/gcd/parity/Arf data. A separate full source/proof audit passed, including puncture conventions, boundary orientations, exceptional inputs and the noncircular termination argument.

## Evidence and scope
- Frozen author proof SHA256: `61130af734e4d1ad68d292b29546f562858fa6aafc6eb92f2e7d2e3d3c1c0a3a`
- Author manifest: `11a691554dd5f480561753bf372b54854caddf778d7a493bbff8e0b1dfe6b418`
- Independent review manifest: `e0ec52005e36e8e9549cb544b29598378493136d3a3d89c857c759bbc363ea07`
- Public manifest: `3caefd94f2d7de37ecfeeca31c9c5a10a4e5d2a501327efc35911cb7f0a328dd`
- Author controls: 1,328; independent assertions: 32,291. Supplementary finite checks, not the universal proof or a full implementation
- Bibliographic qualification preserves workshop/report 2020 and EMS publication 10 February 2021; final APS paper is 2023
- Only this target’s compact mathematical artifacts and its QUEUE row change. Source PDFs/images and raw imports are excluded from the final tree; frozen hashes and author ancestry preserved

Built on fresh main `2109532d61c011cdc4ce2ebcaea557000b1d705e`, with author parent `182dbac2300390a60c43d1bc083d1e7b39ed2fb9`. All 17 artifacts and the sole queue-row change were read back byte-exact before opening this draft. One turn completed, not a five-turn-budget exhaustion.

Sources: [OWR problem](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46842), [APS final](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00029-022-00822-x), [PPP construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.04730), [EMS publication date](https://ems.press/journals/owr/issues/1220).
